title: Top of Cubes Do Not Close Correctly
text: Top of Cubes Do Not Close Correctly. The top of the cube does not close completely.  The top is counter balanced with metal bars underneath.  One bar is apparently heavier than the other, causing the top to stay open on one side.  I took two small nails and taped them underneath by the bar on the sides that needed more weight to keep them closed. .
